record.question: In the last General Election of Mizoram Legislative Assembly, the M.N.F. secured
record.explanation: Answer C: 3 seats. The last Assembly general election before 24 March 2010 was the 2008 election. The state government's Statistical Abstract 2009 lists exactly three MNF winners: East Tuipui, Lunglei West and Lawngtlai West. The separate Palak winner is labelled MDF (MNF), an allied party rather than an additional MNF seat. Historical/source note: 2008 election party tally; distinguish MNF's own three seats from its MDF ally. Reference: https://des.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2a4592a93e8f66c59d8ef565cb7038b9/pages-99-statabstact2009.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
